name: B10-0380/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified soybean GMB151 x DAS-44406-6 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow imports of food and animal feed made from a genetically modified soybean. The soybean is engineered to survive several weedkillers, including one banned in the EU. Parliament says the safety checks were incomplete and that EU farmers would face unfair competition. This is Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change the law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to drop the plan.
- **Who it affects:** EU importers, food and feed businesses, and EU farmers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw or go ahead.
